name: Coming-Soon
description: This is a Python script for generating a "Coming Soon" pre-roll using iCAL data from Radarr or Sonarr.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Path to the config directory. This is where the script will look for the input file.

paths.name: Output Path
paths.description: Path to the output directory. This is where the generated video will be saved.

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for when to run the script.

variables.name: Template - Video File
variables.description: A video file that the text will be overlaid onto. This file must exist in the Config Path directory.

variables.name: Template - Font File
variables.description: A font file that the text will be overlaid onto. This file must exist in the Config Path directory. Remove this to use the default font (Arial).

variables.name: Template - Font Size
variables.description: Font size of the text overlay.

variables.name: Template - Font Color
variables.description: Font color of the text overlay. Allowed values: https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-utils.html#color-syntax

variables.name: Template - Text Location (X)
variables.description: X coordinate of the top-left-most pixel for the text overlay.

variables.name: Template - Text Location (Y)
variables.description: Y coordinate of the top-left-most pixel for the text overlay.

variables.name: Template - Center Text
variables.description: Center the text overlay on the screen. Will override X and Y positions.

variables.name: Template - Line Spacing
variables.description: Line spacing of the text overlay.

variables.name: Template - Text Start Time
variables.description: How many seconds into the video to start the text overlay.

variables.name: Template - Text End Time
variables.description: How many seconds into the video to end the text overlay.
